semantic_method.passage_split: sentence boundaries (regex (?<=[.!?])\s+), at most passage_words words per passage
semantic_method.page_vector: mean of the passage vectors, divided by its own length (unit length)
semantic_method.similarity: cosine = dot product of page vectors; computed for all pairs from one matrix product
semantic_method.text_sources: page = Wikipedia extract; description_fallback = node description (as in build_week7_test.py); no_text = nothing to embed, excluded from similarities

graph_method.graph: directed; edge A->B = article A links to article B; only the 370 category pages are nodes
graph_method.distance: number of links on the shortest directed path (BFS per node, scipy.sparse.csgraph); null when unreachable
graph_method.pair_convention: A = node_id sorting first, B = the other; d_ab: A->B, d_ba: B->A

consistency_with_week7_supervillains_jso.note: that file stores cosines rounded to 3 decimals, so differences up to 0.0005 are rounding
